concept.coreMechanic: A reusable, manually aimed melee thrust combines a weighty stone impact with a delayed gel-and-stone collateral splash. Each direct hit schedules a small burst at the recorded impact position 10 ticks later, rewarding attacks into clustered enemies without guaranteeing that moving enemies remain inside it. The base thrust cadence remains 31 ticks, matching the gel spear.
concept.literalSynthesis: Статуя копья (Terraria/SpearStatue) becomes a portable carved-stone spear, retaining its sculptural stone identity beneath the translucent gel coating of Гелевое копье (InfiniCrafterLocal/GeneratedItem). The stone point sits inside a rounded gel sheath, with small stone chips suspended in the coating. This is an item presentation direction, not a delivered image.
concept.parentAContribution: Статуя копья supplies the literal carved-stone spear identity. Its newly authored mechanical contribution is a heavier direct impact and the stone-chip character of the delayed burst; these are synthesis mechanics, not claimed abilities of the original statue. Native statue placement is intentionally not inherited.
concept.parentBContribution: Гелевое копье supplies the translucent coating, reusable owner-attached extension/retraction action, 31-tick base tempo and small collateral splash idea. The splash is intentionally delayed rather than immediate, interpreting the gel as briefly holding and then releasing stone fragments.

plannedPlayerActions.intent: Manually thrust the gel-coated stone spear toward the cursor.

concept.playerExperience: Click toward an enemy to deliver a bounded thrust with strong knockback. Nearby enemies can take a modest delayed collateral hit, while the directly struck enemy is excluded from that hit's splash. No mana, ammo or item consumption is required; manual use, limited reach and the delayed burst constrain this sustained free attack.

generatedParentSummary.description: The program defines a reusable melee item represented during attacks by one owner-attached thrust entity. The normal item-use graphic and custom held root are hidden; the thrust is the intended visible physical representation. Its proposed appearance combines the carved stone identity of Статуя копья with the translucent spear coating of Гелевое копье; this response does not supply a rendered asset. Primary use creates one capped thrust aimed along the initial cursor axis. Over a 31-world-tick extension/retraction cycle, its collision center travels from an 18-pixel owner-center baseline to a peak additional displacement of 48 pixels, then retracts. Its 21-by-21-pixel hitbox deals 10 base melee damage with 7 knockback, requires the native owner hit check and directly hits each NPC at most once per thrust. Tile collision is disabled. Every direct hit schedules a 1.5-tile-radius area attack at the recorded event position after 10 ticks. This collateral attack excludes that event's directly hit NPC and uses half the authored projectile base damage, or 5 before defense and applicable native damage rules. It creates no child projectiles. No alternate use, statue placement, passive equipment effect or status application is authored.

The chips are a newly authored synthesis mechanic, not an asserted ability of the block parent.
